name: crm-create-case-committed — CRM REST write claim/case (BRD §8.4) → committed + Tool Execution
$comment: Sigorta hasar bildirimi: claim/case kaydı oluştur → referans numarası (BRD §8.4). REST write idempotent; key var, authz write, allowlist permit, attempt 201. committed → tool_execution (WORM, R9). result_ref referans numarası taşır. Sentetik (FR-TST-008).
